components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action: Register and section CTAs.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;height:44px;padding:0 20px;border-radius:8px;border:0;font-family:var(--font-ui, 'Work Sans', system-ui, sans-serif);font-size:15px;font-weight:600;text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .2s ease,transform .2s ease,box-shadow .2s ease;background:var(--color-primary,#1A7F52);color:var(--color-primary-foreground,#FFFFFF)} .ds-btn-primary:hover{background:var(--color-primary-hover,#14653F);transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 14px 28px -14px rgb(20 40 30 / .45)} .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--color-ring,#1A7F52);outline-offset:3px;}

components.name: Highlight Button

components.name: Outline Button

components.css: .ds-btn-outline{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;height:44px;padding:0 20px;border-radius:8px;border:0;font-family:var(--font-ui, 'Work Sans', system-ui, sans-serif);font-size:15px;font-weight:600;text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .2s ease,transform .2s ease,box-shadow .2s ease;background:transparent;color:var(--color-foreground,#1C3B2C);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--color-border,rgb(28 59 44 / .14))} .ds-btn-outline:hover{background:var(--color-card,#FFFFFF);color:var(--color-card-foreground,#1C3B2C);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1.5px color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-link,#1A7F52) 50%, transparent)} .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--color-ring,#1A7F52);outline-offset:3px;}

components.css: .ds-opener{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px;max-width:620px;color:var(--color-foreground,#1C3B2C)} .ds-eyebrow{font-family:var(--font-ui, 'Work Sans', system-ui, sans-serif);font-size:14px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--color-link,#1A7F52)} .ds-headline{margin:0;font-family:var(--font-ui, 'Work Sans', system-ui, sans-serif);font-weight:800;font-size:clamp(2.25rem,1.5rem + 2.2vw,3.125rem);line-height:1.04;letter-spacing:-.02em;text-wrap:balance} .ds-headline span{color:var(--color-emphasis,#1A8B5A)} .ds-lead{margin:8px 0 0;font-family:var(--font-body, Merriweather, Georgia, serif);font-size:clamp(1.125rem,1rem + .4vw,1.25rem);line-height:1.6;color:var(--color-muted-foreground,#3E5A4B)}

components.name: Quote Card

components.css: .ds-quote{margin:0;max-width:300px;background:var(--color-fill-quiet,#F1E7CE);color:var(--color-fill-quiet-foreground,#1C3B2C);border-radius:12px;padding:28px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px} .ds-quote-mark{font-family:var(--font-ui, 'Work Sans', system-ui, sans-serif);font-weight:800;font-size:56px;line-height:.6;height:22px;overflow:hidden;color:var(--color-mark,#1A8B5A)} .ds-quote blockquote{margin:0;font-family:var(--font-ui, 'Work Sans', system-ui, sans-serif);font-weight:700;font-size:18px;line-height:1.4} .ds-quote figcaption{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px} .ds-sig{font-family:var(--font-accent, Caveat, cursive);font-weight:600;font-size:24px;line-height:1;transform:rotate(-2deg);transform-origin:left center} .ds-role{font-family:var(--font-ui, 'Work Sans', system-ui, sans-serif);font-size:14px;font-weight:600}

components.name: Date Badge
components.description: Month and day range overlapping a camp photo.

narrative.overview: The site feels like a bright afternoon at camp: a warm cream ground, deep camp green, and one marigold sun, with lake sky as the cool shade and a counselor's handwritten note in the margin. It is warm and plain-spoken, and the photographs of children at camp carry it. Sections are full-width fields of cream, sand or dark forest green with soft glows in the corners and a fine grain; cards are flat and lightly outlined.
keyCharacteristics: Cream ground, camp green for action, marigold for warmth and giving, lake sky as the cool second colour.
Work Sans 800 headlines, Merriweather sentences, Caveat notes.
One accent phrase per headline, in the emphasis colour of the field.
8px buttons, 12px cards, circles for portraits and the photo ring.
Glow and grain on the fields; flat cards with hairlines.

rules.name: The Job Token Rule
rules.body: Component code uses only job tokens (bg-primary, text-link, card-warm…). Brand colours exist only in globals.css and Tailwind generates no classes for them; a rebrand changes one file.

rules.name: The Ink-on-Colour Rule
rules.body: Marigold, lake sky and sand always carry ink text (highlight-foreground and the card-* utilities); only camp green, camp green deep, error and ink (the Forest field and fill-deep) carry light text.

rules.name: The Big Green Rule
rules.body: Logo green (mark, and emphasis on Cream) is for marks, rings, rules and heading-size words; small green text uses text-link, which is camp green on Cream and camp green deep on Sand.

rules.name: The Sun Rule
rules.body: One or two highlight or fill-warm (marigold) elements per screen.

rules.name: The Sentence Rule
rules.body: Every sentence is Merriweather; every heading, label, button and link is Work Sans.

rules.name: The One Hand Rule
rules.body: Caveat appears once or twice per section as a short note, never as a heading or interface text.

rules.name: The Short Caps Rule
rules.body: Uppercase is for eyebrows of one to three words only.

rules.name: The Flat-at-Rest Rule
rules.body: Cards are flat; a shadow appears only under an overlapping element or on hover.

dos: Do use job tokens (bg-background, text-foreground, text-link, text-emphasis, bg-primary, bg-highlight, card-warm…) and the role utilities.
Do set a section's background with its field and let the field tokens adapt the content.
Do put the matching -foreground text on every fill: ink on marigold, lake sky and sand, and white on camp green.
Do take spacing from the 4px scale.
Do lead with big photographs of children at camp.
Do show cost, the donor share and the campership tier openly.
donts: Don't use brand colour names in component code; if a job is missing, add a job token in globals.css.
Don't use the deprecated CAC names in new code.
Don't add "on dark" variants for the Forest field; the field tokens already handle it.
Don't use text-emphasis, text-mark or marigold for small text on light fields.
Don't add a second accent phrase to a headline.
Don't set a status line or sentence in uppercase.
Don't make it look like a clinic.
